query:
SELECT 
  branchId,
  DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as item_count
FROM inventory
WHERE branchId IN (20, 300012)
GROUP BY branchId, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY branchId, month;
